name: bundle
description: Key bundle canonical bytes and signatures (E2EE 3.1): seq 1 for cs=1 (514 bytes) and cs=2 with pq_id (13071 bytes), seq 2 with sig_prev (ik rotation). sig_ik = Ed25519(ik, "cx1/bundle" || 0x00 || canonical), sig_prev = Ed25519(ik_prev, "cx1/rotate" || 0x00 || canonical), sig_pq = ML-DSA-65 (deterministic) over the same bundle statement.

vectors.what: seq 1, cs=2, lk_ok, pq_id, policy e2ee, min_cs 2
seq 2, ik rotated (sig_prev by the seq-1 ik), prev_hash = sha256(seq-1 canonical)

negative.what: ik byte flipped (signature no longer verifies under the bundle's own ik)
rotation checked against the wrong previous ik
